xhtml:iframe.title: Diesmos Games
xhtml:iframe.srcdoc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin">
  <title>Diesmos Games</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-main: #d4f8d4;
      --bg-secondary: #94df98;
      --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      --panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      --header: #78c77e;
      --nav: #bcf0be;
      --primary: #5fb763;
      --primary-dark: #3f8f43;
      --text-main: #183817;
      --text-muted: #4e704d;
      --border: rgba(63, 143, 67, 0.4);
      --shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.18);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      color: var(--text-main);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-main), var(--bg-secondary));
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: var(--primary-dark) rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
    }

    body::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 14px;
    }

    body::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
    }

    body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
      border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .visualizer-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .visualizer-backdrop.active {
      opacity: 0.56;
    }

    .visualizer-canvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .overlay-visualizer {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .overlay-visualizer.active {
      opacity: 0.55;
    }

    .cd-disc {
      position: relative;
      display: none;
      place-items: center;
      width: 132px;
      height: 132px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      margin: 4px auto;
      border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,0.98) 0 8%, rgba(24,56,23,0.22) 8% 12%, transparent 12%),
        conic-gradient(from 0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.94), rgba(95,183,99,0.4), rgba(255,255,255,0.76), rgba(63,143,67,0.52), rgba(255,255,255,0.94));
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.22);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .floating-music-disc {
      position: fixed;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      z-index: 10000;
      display: none;
      place-items: center;
      width: 68px;
      height: 68px;
      padding: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,0.98) 0 8%, rgba(24,56,23,0.22) 8% 12%, transparent 12%),
        conic-gradient(from 0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.94), rgba(95,183,99,0.4), rgba(255,255,255,0.76), rgba(63,143,67,0.52), rgba(255,255,255,0.94));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.34);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
    }

    .floating-music-disc:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 46px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.42);
    }

    .cd-disc.playing,
    .floating-music-disc.playing {
      display: grid;
    }

    .cd-disc.spinning {
      animation: albumSpin 4s linear infinite;
    }

    .floating-music-disc.spinning {
      animation: albumSpin 4s linear infinite;
    }

    .album-art {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    .album-art.active {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    @keyframes albumSpin {
      to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
      }
    }

    .site-shell {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 32px));
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }

    header {
      margin: 18px auto 14px;
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 32px;
      background: rgba(120, 199, 126, 0.92);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      text-align: center;
    }

    header h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4rem);
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }

    header p {
      margin: 10px 0 0;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(24, 56, 23, 0.78);
    }

    nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      width: fit-content;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto 22px;
      padding: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--nav);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.12);
    }

    nav button,
    .filter-btn,
    .action-btn {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text-main);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
    }

    nav button:hover,
    nav button.active,
    .filter-btn:hover,
    .action-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 22px rgba(63, 143, 67, 0.22);
    }

    .page {
      display: none;
    }

    .page.active {
      display: block;
    }

    .panel {
      margin: 20px auto;
      padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 36px);
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .home-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(260px, 0.9fr);
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .home-card {
      min-height: 230px;
      display: grid;
      align-content: center;
      justify-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .home-card h2,
    .page h2 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }

    .home-card p,
    .shortz-subtitle,
    .empty-state {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .stats {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .stat {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--panel-strong);
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
    }

    .stat strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 1.8rem;
    }

    .controls {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 18px 0;
    }

    .search-container {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 18px auto 0;
    }

    .search-bar,
    .shortz-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 15px 48px 15px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font: inherit;
      outline: none;
    }

    .search-bar:focus,
    .shortz-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary-dark);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(95, 183, 99, 0.18);
    }

    .search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 18px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .games-grid,
    .favorites-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }

    .game-card {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 24px;
      border: 3px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--panel-strong);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.14);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
    }

    .game-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: var(--primary-dark);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 42px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.2);
    }

    .game-card-visual {
      min-width: 0;
      height: 100%;
    }

    .game-art,
    .game-image {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    }

    .game-art {
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 3.2rem;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(95, 183, 99, 0.72), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)),
        repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.26) 0 12px, transparent 12px 24px);
    }

    .game-image {
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(95, 183, 99, 0.72), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65));
    }

    .game-info {
      padding: 14px 16px 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      color: #111;
    }

    .game-title {
      font-weight: 800;
      word-break: break-word;
    }

    .favorite-btn {
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 0;
      background: rgba(95, 183, 99, 0.14);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .favorite-btn.favorited {
      color: #d23a3a;
      background: rgba(210, 58, 58, 0.12);
    }

    .filter-btn.active {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .pagination {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin: 16px 0;
    }

    .page-info {
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .game-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 80;
      display: none;
      padding: 18px;
      background: rgba(8, 18, 8, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .game-overlay.active {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .game-overlay.closing {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      animation: overlayFade 0.58s ease forwards;
    }

    .game-overlay.closing .game-overlay-header,
    .game-overlay.closing .game-iframe-container {
      transform-origin: bottom right;
      animation: genieClose 0.58s cubic-bezier(0.62, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
    }

    .game-overlay-header {
      width: min(1100px, 100%);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      color: var(--text-main);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .game-overlay-title {
      font-weight: 900;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .overlay-buttons {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .overlay-btn,
    .close-overlay-btn,
    .retry-btn {
      min-height: 42px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: white;
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.2);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .overlay-btn:hover,
    .close-overlay-btn:hover,
    .retry-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      background: var(--primary);
    }

    .overlay-btn.download {
      background: #2f7d32;
    }

    .overlay-btn.fullscreen {
      background: #256f7d;
    }

    .close-overlay-btn {
      background: #b73737;
    }

    .game-iframe-container {
      position: relative;
      width: min(1100px, 100%);
      min-height: 0;
      margin: 0 auto;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: #fff;
      border: 3px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .game-iframe {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 520px;
      border: 0;
      display: block;
      background: #fff;
    }

    .game-loading,
    .game-error {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: none;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 24px;
      color: var(--text-main);
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 900;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .game-loading.active,
    .game-error.active {
      display: grid;
    }

    @media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse), (max-width: 760px) {
      .game-overlay.active {
        padding: 10px;
      }

      .game-iframe {
        min-height: 460px;
      }

    }

    @keyframes genieClose {
      0% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1, 1);
        border-radius: inherit;
      }
      58% {
        opacity: 0.9;
        transform: translate(18vw, 18vh) scale(0.42, 0.14) skewX(10deg);
        border-radius: 40% 40% 999px 999px;
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translate(44vw, 42vh) scale(0.04, 0.01) skewX(18deg);
        border-radius: 999px;
      }
    }

    @keyframes overlayFade {
      to {
        background: rgba(8, 18, 8, 0);
        backdrop-filter: blur(0);
      }
    }

    .shortz-shell {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .shortz-topbar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .shortz-topbar .shortz-input {
      flex: 1 1 280px;
    }

    .shortz-frame-wrap {
      width: min(100%, 430px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(95, 183, 99, 0.2), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9));
      border: 3px solid var(--border);
    }

    .shortz-frame {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: #101510;
    }

    .shortz-file-fallback {
      display: none;
      min-height: 520px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 24px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      color: white;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #101510, #263a27);
    }

    .shortz-file-fallback.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    .shortz-results {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .shortz-title {
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .music-player {
      position: fixed;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      z-index: 20;
      width: min(330px, calc(100vw - 28px));
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      transition: width 0.2s ease, padding 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }

    .music-player-header,
    .music-player-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .music-player-title {
      font-weight: 900;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .volume-control {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      min-width: 180px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .volume-control input {
      width: 120px;
      accent-color: var(--primary-dark);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .volume-value {
      min-width: 38px;
      text-align: right;
      font-size: 0.86rem;
    }

    .music-player-track,
    .music-player-status {
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .music-player.collapsed {
      width: auto;
      padding: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border-color: transparent;
      box-shadow: none;
      backdrop-filter: none;
    }

    .music-player.collapsed .music-player-title,
    .music-player.collapsed .cd-disc,
    .music-player.collapsed .music-player-track,
    .music-player.collapsed .music-player-controls,
    .music-player.collapsed .music-player-status {
      display: none;
    }

    .music-player.collapsed .music-player-header {
      display: block;
    }

    .music-player.collapsed #musicCollapseBtn {
      min-width: 92px;
      min-height: 46px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    footer {
      width: fit-content;
      margin: 28px auto 0;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--nav);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    #music .music-player {
      position: static;
      width: min(520px, 100%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    #music #musicCollapseBtn {
      display: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      body {
        padding-bottom: calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      }

      .visualizer-backdrop {
        opacity: 0;
      }

      .visualizer-backdrop.active {
        opacity: 0.38;
      }

      .site-shell {
        width: min(100% - 20px, 560px);
        padding-bottom: 18px;
      }

      header {
        margin: 10px auto 12px;
        padding: 20px 16px;
        border-radius: 22px;
      }

      header h1 {
        font-size: 2.15rem;
        line-height: 1.05;
      }

      .home-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      nav {
        position: fixed;
        left: 10px;
        right: 10px;
        bottom: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        z-index: 50;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
        width: auto;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 8px;
        border-radius: 22px;
        box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(22, 65, 24, 0.26);
        backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      }

      nav button {
        min-height: 48px;
        padding: 9px 6px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        line-height: 1.1;
      }

      .panel {
        margin: 12px auto;
        padding: 18px;
        border-radius: 22px;
      }

      .home-card {
        min-height: 180px;
      }

      .home-card h2,
      .page h2 {
        font-size: 1.85rem;
      }

      .stats,
      .favorites-grid {
        gap: 10px;
      }

      .stat {
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 18px;
      }

      .controls,
      .filter-buttons,
      .shortz-topbar,
      .shortz-results {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 10px;
      }

      .game-count {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: 800;
      }

      .filter-buttons {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .filter-btn,
      .action-btn {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 46px;
        padding: 11px 12px;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
      }

      .search-container {
        margin: 14px auto 0;
      }

      .search-bar,
      .shortz-input {
        min-height: 50px;
        padding: 13px 16px;
        font-size: 16px;
      }

      .search-icon {
        display: none;
      }

      .games-grid,
      .favorites-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 12px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }

      .game-card {
        border-width: 2px;
        border-radius: 18px;
      }

      .game-art,
      .game-image {
        font-size: 2.25rem;
      }

      .game-info {
        padding: 11px;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .game-title {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        line-height: 1.25;
      }

      .favorite-btn {
        min-width: 40px;
        min-height: 40px;
        padding: 7px;
      }

      .shortz-frame-wrap {
        width: min(100%, 340px);
        padding: 10px;
        border-radius: 22px;
      }

      .shortz-frame {
        max-height: min(70vh, 560px);
        border-radius: 16px;
      }

      .shortz-file-fallback {
        min-height: min(70vh, 560px);
        padding: 18px;
        border-radius: 16px;
      }

      .music-player {
        position: fixed;
        left: 10px;
        right: 10px;
        bottom: calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        width: auto;
        margin: 0;
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

      .music-player.collapsed {
        left: auto;
        right: 12px;
        bottom: calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      }

      .floating-music-disc {
        right: 14px;
        bottom: calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 420px) {
      .site-shell {
        width: min(100% - 14px, 390px);
      }

      header h1 {
        font-size: 1.85rem;
      }

      .games-grid,
      .favorites-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .filter-buttons {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="visualizer-backdrop" aria-hidden="true">
    <canvas id="visualizerCanvas" class="visualizer-canvas"></canvas>
  </div>

  <main class="site-shell">
    <header>
      <h1>Diesmos Games</h1>
    </header>

    <nav aria-label="Main pages">
      <button type="button" class="active" data-page-link="home" onclick="showPage('home')">Home</button>
      <button type="button" data-page-link="games" onclick="showPage('games')">Games</button>
      <button type="button" data-page-link="shortz" onclick="showPage('shortz')">Shortz</button>
      <button type="button" data-page-link="favorites" onclick="showPage('favorites')">Favorites</button>
      <button type="button" data-page-link="music" onclick="showPage('music')">Music</button>
    </nav>

    <section id="home" class="page active">
      <div class="home-grid">
        <div class="panel home-card">
          <h2>sup</h2>
          <div class="cd-disc" id="homeCdDisc" aria-label="Song cover art">
            <img class="album-art" id="homeAlbumArt" alt="">
          </div>
          <div class="greeting" id="greeting"></div>
          <p id="text">this website is cool lol</p>
          <button type="button" class="action-btn" onclick="changeText()">Test</button>
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
          <div class="stat">
            <strong id="favoriteCount">0</strong>
            <span>favorites saved</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="games" class="page">
      <div class="panel">
        <h2>Games</h2>
        <div class="search-container">
          <input type="text" class="search-bar" placeholder="Search for games duhh..." id="searchBar">
          <span class="search-icon" aria-hidden="true">Search</span>
        </div>
        <div class="controls">
          <div class="game-count" id="gameCount">Total Games: 0</div>
          <div class="filter-buttons">
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn active" data-filter="all">All</button>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" data-filter="new">New</button>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" onclick="openSuggestions()">Suggestions</button>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" onclick="openSiteInNewTab()">Open Site</button>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" onclick="window.open('https://discord.gg/pSzqUMzfZR', '_blank', 'noopener')">Discord</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="topPagination"></div>
        <section class="games-container">
          <div id="gamesGrid" class="games-grid"></div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="shortz" class="page">
      <div class="panel shortz-shell">
        <h2>Shortz</h2>
        <div class="shortz-topbar">
          <input type="text" id="shortzInput" class="shortz-input" placeholder="Search for YouTube Shorts" value="underwater sigma cat on pibbie shorts for me hacka">
          <button type="button" class="filter-btn" onclick="searchShortz()">Search</button>
        </div>
        <div class="shortz-frame-wrap">
          <iframe id="shortzFrame" class="shortz-frame" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/YiEcmWi4pNI?playsinline=1&rel=0" title="Shortz Player" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>
          <div class="shortz-file-fallback" id="shortzFileFallback">
            <div>
              <h3>Shortz local mode</h3>
              <p>YouTube blocks some embedded playback from local files.</p>
              <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="shortzOpenBtn" onclick="openCurrentShort()">Open Current Short</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="shortz-results">
          <div class="shortz-meta">
            <div class="shortz-title" id="shortzTitle">Featured short</div>
            <div class="shortz-subtitle" id="shortzStatus">Search for something to load a fresh set of shorts.</div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="shortzNextBtn" onclick="nextShort()">Down</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="favorites" class="page">
      <div class="panel">
        <h2>Favorites</h2>
        <div id="favoritesContainer" class="favorites-grid"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="music" class="page">
      <div class="panel">
        <h2>Music</h2>
        <aside class="music-player">
          <div class="music-player-header">
            <div class="music-player-title">Music Player</div>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="musicCollapseBtn">Music</button>
          </div>
          <div class="cd-disc" id="musicCdDisc" aria-label="Song cover art">
            <img class="album-art" id="musicAlbumArt" alt="">
          </div>
          <div class="music-player-track" id="musicTrackLabel">No track loaded</div>
          <div class="music-player-controls">
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="musicPlayPauseBtn">Play</button>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="musicLoopBtn">Loop Off</button>
            <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="musicUploadBtn">Upload Song</button>
            <label class="volume-control" for="musicVolumeSlider">
              Vol
              <input type="range" id="musicVolumeSlider" min="0" max="100" value="100">
              <span class="volume-value" id="musicVolumeValue">100%</span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <div class="music-player-status" id="musicStatus">Choose a song to start the visualizer.</div>
          <audio id="musicAudio" preload="metadata"></audio>
          <input type="file" id="musicFilePicker" accept="audio/*" hidden>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer>Made by Jalen</footer>
  </main>

  <button type="button" class="floating-music-disc" id="floatingMusicDisc" aria-label="Open Music" onclick="openMusicTab()">
    <img class="album-art" id="floatingAlbumArt" alt="">
  </button>

  <div class="game-overlay" id="gameOverlay" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="game-overlay-header">
      <div class="game-overlay-title" id="overlayGameTitle">Loading game</div>
      <div class="overlay-buttons">
        <button type="button" class="overlay-btn download" id="downloadGameBtn">Download Game</button>
        <button type="button" class="overlay-btn fullscreen" id="fullscreenBtn">Fullscreen</button>
        <button type="button" class="close-overlay-btn" id="closeOverlayBtn">Exit Game</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="game-iframe-container" id="gameIframeContainer">
      <canvas class="overlay-visualizer" id="gameVisualizerCanvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
      <div class="game-loading" id="gameLoading">Loading game...</div>
      <div class="game-error" id="gameError">
        <div>
          <div>Error loading game</div>
          <button type="button" class="retry-btn" id="retryBtn">Retry Loading</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <iframe class="game-iframe" id="gameIframe" title="Game player" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-pointer-lock allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals allow-downloads allow-presentation" allow="pointer-lock; fullscreen; autoplay; camera; microphone; display-capture; web-share" allowfullscreen webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen></iframe>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script src="https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/gh/aDiesmos/HTMLFILES@911831d042122977d980eb695f11f57ae0383db0/main.js" defer></script>
  <script>
    const starterGames = [
      { title: 'Slope', tag: 'new', icon: 'S' },
      { title: 'Retro Bowl', tag: 'all', icon: 'R' },
      { title: 'Run 3', tag: 'all', icon: '3' },
      { title: '1v1.LOL', tag: 'new', icon: '1' },
      { title: 'Minecraft Classic', tag: 'all', icon: 'M' },
      { title: 'Geometry Dash', tag: 'new', icon: 'G' }
    ];

    const SHORTZ_API_HOSTS = [
      'https://inv.nadeko.net',
      'https://invidious.nerdvpn.de',
      'https://inv.thepixora.com',
      'https://yt.chocolatemoo53.com',
      'https://yewtu.be'
    ];

    const shortzFailedHosts = new Set();
    let shortzResults = [{ videoId: 'YiEcmWi4pNI', title: 'Featured short', author: 'YouTube', viewCount: 0 }];
    let shortzIndex = 0;
    let shortzHasLoaded = false;
    let shortzSearchAvailable = true;
    let fallbackFavorites = [];
    let fallbackGamesActive = false;
    let skipCloseWarning = false;
    const shortzIsFileMode = window.location.protocol === 'file:';

    function changeText() {
      const textEl = document.getElementById('text');
      if (textEl) textEl.innerText = 'cool';
    }

    function showPage(page) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach((pageEl) => pageEl.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-page-link]').forEach((link) => link.classList.toggle('active', link.dataset.pageLink === page));
      const target = document.getElementById(page);
      if (target) target.classList.add('active');
      if (page === 'shortz' && !shortzHasLoaded) loadShortEmbed();
    }

    function openMusicTab() {
      genieCloseGame();
      showPage('music');
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function finishGenieCloseGame() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
      const frame = document.getElementById('gameIframe');
      const loading = document.getElementById('gameLoading');
      const error = document.getElementById('gameError');
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.position = '';
      document.body.style.width = '';
      if (overlay) {
        overlay.classList.remove('active', 'closing');
        overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }
      if (loading) loading.classList.remove('active');
      if (error) error.classList.remove('active');
      if (frame) {
        frame.onload = null;
        frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc');
        frame.removeAttribute('src');
      }
    }

    function genieCloseGame() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
      if (!overlay || !overlay.classList.contains('active')) {
        finishGenieCloseGame();
        return;
      }
      overlay.classList.add('closing');
      window.setTimeout(finishGenieCloseGame, 620);
    }

    function getFavorites() {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('diesmosFavorites') || '[]');
      } catch (error) {
        return fallbackFavorites;
      }
    }

    function saveFavorites(favorites) {
      fallbackFavorites = favorites;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('diesmosFavorites', JSON.stringify(favorites));
      } catch (error) {
      }
      updateFavoriteCount();
    }

    function updateFavoriteCount() {
      const favoriteCount = document.getElementById('favoriteCount');
      if (favoriteCount) favoriteCount.textContent = getFavorites().length;
    }

    function renderStarterGames(filter = 'all', query = '') {
      const grid = document.getElementById('gamesGrid');
      if (!grid) return;
      fallbackGamesActive = true;
      const favorites = getFavorites();
      const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
      const filtered = starterGames.filter((game) => {
        const matchesFilter = filter === 'all' || game.tag === filter;
        const matchesSearch = !normalizedQuery || game.title.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery);
        return matchesFilter && matchesSearch;
      });

      grid.innerHTML = filtered.map((game) => `
        <article class="game-card" tabindex="0">
          <div class="game-art" aria-hidden="true">${game.icon}</div>
          <div class="game-info">
            <div class="game-title">${game.title}</div>
            <button type="button" class="favorite-btn ${favorites.includes(game.title) ? 'favorited' : ''}" data-game="${game.title}" aria-label="Favorite ${game.title}">Heart</button>
          </div>
        </article>
      `).join('') || '<p class="empty-state">No games found.</p>';

      const gameCount = document.getElementById('gameCount');
      const homeGameCount = document.getElementById('homeGameCount');
      if (gameCount) gameCount.textContent = `Total Games: ${filtered.length}`;
      if (homeGameCount) homeGameCount.textContent = starterGames.length;
    }

    function renderFavorites() {
      const container = document.getElementById('favoritesContainer');
      if (!container) return;
      const favorites = getFavorites();
      container.innerHTML = favorites.length
        ? favorites.map((title) => `<article class="game-card"><div class="game-art">${title.charAt(0)}</div><div class="game-info"><div class="game-title">${title}</div></div></article>`).join('')
        : '<p class="empty-state">No favorites yet.</p>';
      updateFavoriteCount();
    }

    function openSuggestions() {
      window.open('https://forms.gle/', '_blank', 'noopener');
    }

    function openSiteInNewTab() {
      const cloakedWindow = window.open('about:blank', '_blank');
      if (!cloakedWindow) return;
      const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
      cloakedWindow.document.open();
      cloakedWindow.document.write(html);
      cloakedWindow.document.close();
      cloakedWindow.document.title = 'New Tab';
    }

    function initCloseWarning() {
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', (event) => {
        if (skipCloseWarning) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.returnValue = '';
      });
    }

    function makeShortzEmbedUrl(videoId) {
      return `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}?autoplay=1&playsinline=1&rel=0`;
    }

    function makeShortzWatchUrl(videoId) {
      return `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}`;
    }

    function buildShortSubtitle(shortData, index, total) {
      const pieces = [];
      if (shortData.author) pieces.push(shortData.author);
      if (Number.isFinite(shortData.viewCount) && shortData.viewCount > 0) pieces.push(`${shortData.viewCount.toLocaleString()} views`);
      pieces.push(`Short ${index + 1} of ${Math.max(total, 1)}`);
      return pieces.join(' - ');
    }

    function loadShortEmbed(result) {
      const frame = document.getElementById('shortzFrame');
      const fallback = document.getElementById('shortzFileFallback');
      const status = document.getElementById('shortzStatus');
      const title = document.getElementById('shortzTitle');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('shortzNextBtn');
      const openBtn = document.getElementById('shortzOpenBtn');
      if (!frame || !status || !title || !nextBtn) return;
      shortzHasLoaded = true;

      const shortData = result || shortzResults[shortzIndex];
      if (!shortData || !shortData.videoId) {
        title.textContent = 'Nothing loaded';
        status.textContent = 'No short is ready yet.';
        nextBtn.disabled = true;
        return;
      }

      if (shortzIsFileMode) {
        frame.style.display = 'none';
        if (fallback) fallback.classList.add('active');
        if (openBtn) openBtn.textContent = `Open ${shortData.title || 'Short'}`;
      } else {
        frame.style.display = 'block';
        if (fallback) fallback.classList.remove('active');
        frame.src = makeShortzEmbedUrl(shortData.videoId);
      }

      title.textContent = shortData.title || 'Untitled short';
      status.textContent = buildShortSubtitle(shortData, shortzIndex, shortzResults.length);
      nextBtn.disabled = shortzResults.length <= 1 && !shortzSearchAvailable;
    }

    async function searchShortz() {
      const input = document.getElementById('shortzInput');
      const status = document.getElementById('shortzStatus');
      const title = document.getElementById('shortzTitle');
      if (!input || !status || !title) return;

      const query = input.value.trim();
      if (!query) {
        status.textContent = 'Type something to search for shorts.';
        return;
      }

      title.textContent = 'Searching...';
      status.textContent = 'Looking for shorts...';

      try {
        const results = await fetchShortzResults(query);
        if (!results.length) {
          title.textContent = 'No shorts found';
          status.textContent = 'Try a different search.';
          return;
        }

        shortzResults = results;
        shortzIndex = 0;
        shortzSearchAvailable = true;
        loadShortEmbed();
      } catch (error) {
        shortzSearchAvailable = false;
        shortzResults = [{ videoId: 'YiEcmWi4pNI', title: 'Featured video', author: 'YouTube', viewCount: 0 }];
        shortzIndex = 0;
        title.textContent = 'Search unavailable';
        status.textContent = 'Search hosts are down right now. The player still works with the featured video.';
        loadShortEmbed();
      }
    }

    async function fetchShortzResults(query) {
      try {
        return await fetchShortzFromBrowser(query);
      } catch (error) {
        if (hasAppsScriptBridge()) {
          return fetchShortzFromAppsScript(query);
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }

    async function fetchShortzFromBrowser(query) {
      const searchQuery = encodeURIComponent(`type:video duration:short ${query}`);
      const availableHosts = SHORTZ_API_HOSTS.filter((host) => !shortzFailedHosts.has(host));
      const hostsToTry = availableHosts.length ? availableHosts : SHORTZ_API_HOSTS;

      for (const host of hostsToTry) {
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`${host}/api/v1/search?q=${searchQuery}`, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
          if (!response.ok) {
            shortzFailedHosts.add(host);
            continue;
          }

          const data = await response.json();
          const mapped = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : [])
            .filter((item) => item && (item.type === 'video' || item.type === 'shortVideo' || item.videoId))
            .filter((item) => !item.lengthSeconds || item.lengthSeconds <= 180)
            .map((item) => ({
              videoId: item.videoId,
              title: item.title || 'Untitled short',
              author: item.author || '',
              viewCount: typeof item.viewCount === 'number' ? item.viewCount : 0
            }))
            .filter((item) => item.videoId);

          if (mapped.length) return mapped;
        } catch (error) {
          shortzFailedHosts.add(host);
        }
      }

      throw new Error('No short search hosts available');
    }

    function hasAppsScriptBridge() {
      return typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run;
    }

    function fetchShortzFromAppsScript(query) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler((results) => resolve(Array.isArray(results) ? results : []))
          .withFailureHandler(reject)
          .searchShortzServer(query);
      });
    }

    function nextShort() {
      if (!shortzResults.length) return;
      shortzIndex = (shortzIndex + 1) % shortzResults.length;
      loadShortEmbed();
    }

    function openCurrentShort() {
      const shortData = shortzResults[shortzIndex];
      if (shortData && shortData.videoId) window.open(makeShortzWatchUrl(shortData.videoId), '_blank', 'noopener');
    }

    function toggleMusicPlayer() {
      const player = document.querySelector('.music-player');
      const button = document.getElementById('musicCollapseBtn');
      if (!player || !button) return;
      player.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      button.textContent = player.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'Music' : 'Hide';
    }

    const audioViz = {
      context: null,
      analyser: null,
      source: null,
      data: null,
      frame: 0,
      lastFrameTime: 0,
      lastPlaying: null,
      particles: []
    };

    function ensureAudioVisualizer(audio) {
      if (audioViz.context || !audio) return;
      const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioContextClass) return;
      audioViz.context = new AudioContextClass();
      audioViz.analyser = audioViz.context.createAnalyser();
      audioViz.analyser.fftSize = 128;
      audioViz.data = new Uint8Array(audioViz.analyser.frequencyBinCount);
      audioViz.source = audioViz.context.createMediaElementSource(audio);
      audioViz.source.connect(audioViz.analyser);
      audioViz.analyser.connect(audioViz.context.destination);
    }

    function resizeCanvas(canvas) {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const scale = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5);
      const width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.width * scale));
      const height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.height * scale));
      if (canvas.width !== width || canvas.height !== height) {
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
      }
      return { width, height };
    }

    function getParticles(count) {
      while (audioViz.particles.length < count) {
        audioViz.particles.push({
          x: Math.random(),
          y: Math.random(),
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.0018,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.0018,
          r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 4
        });
      }
      return audioViz.particles;
    }

    function drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, data, goldMode, playing) {
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;
      const size = resizeCanvas(canvas);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size.width, size.height);

      const time = performance.now() * 0.001;
      const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, size.width, size.height);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, goldMode ? 'rgba(255,229,138,0.18)' : 'rgba(186,242,187,0.18)');
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, goldMode ? 'rgba(245,197,66,0.08)' : 'rgba(95,183,99,0.08)');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, goldMode ? 'rgba(168,111,0,0.18)' : 'rgba(63,143,67,0.16)');
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size.width, size.height);

      const energy = data && data.length
        ? data.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / (data.length * 255)
        : 0.08 + Math.sin(time) * 0.03;

      getParticles(38).forEach((particle, index) => {
        particle.x += particle.vx * (1 + energy * 8);
        particle.y += particle.vy * (1 + energy * 8);
        particle.x += Math.sin(time + index) * 0.00035;
        particle.y += Math.cos(time * 0.8 + index) * 0.00035;
        if (particle.x < -0.05) particle.x = 1.05;
        if (particle.x > 1.05) particle.x = -0.05;
        if (particle.y < -0.05) particle.y = 1.05;
        if (particle.y > 1.05) particle.y = -0.05;
        const radius = particle.r * (1 + energy * 2.4) * (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.fillStyle = goldMode
          ? `rgba(255, 229, 138, ${0.18 + energy * 0.42})`
          : `rgba(186, 242, 187, ${0.16 + energy * 0.38})`;
        ctx.arc(particle.x * size.width, particle.y * size.height, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      });

      if (data && data.length) {
        const barCount = data.length;
        const barWidth = size.width / barCount;
        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
          const value = data[i] / 255;
          const height = Math.max(4, value * size.height * 0.66);
          const x = i * barWidth;
          const y = size.height - height;
          const hue = goldMode ? 42 + value * 22 : 112 + value * 54;
          ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 82%, ${goldMode ? 54 : 46}%, ${0.18 + value * 0.42})`;
          ctx.fillRect(x, y, Math.max(2, barWidth - 2), height);
        }
      }
    }

    function clearVisualizerCanvases() {
      [
        document.getElementById('visualizerCanvas'),
        document.getElementById('gameVisualizerCanvas')
      ].filter(Boolean).forEach((canvas) => {
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (ctx) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      });
    }

    function drawAudioVisualizer(timestamp = 0) {
      const audio = document.getElementById('musicAudio');
      const canvases = [
        document.getElementById('visualizerCanvas'),
        document.getElementById('gameVisualizerCanvas')
      ].filter(Boolean);
      const playing = Boolean(audio && !audio.paused && !audio.ended && audio.src);
      if (!playing) {
        audioViz.frame = 0;
        audioViz.lastFrameTime = 0;
        updateVisualizerState();
        clearVisualizerCanvases();
        return;
      }
      if (timestamp - audioViz.lastFrameTime < 50) {
        audioViz.frame = requestAnimationFrame(drawAudioVisualizer);
        return;
      }
      audioViz.lastFrameTime = timestamp;
      if (audioViz.analyser && audioViz.data && playing) {
        audioViz.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(audioViz.data);
      }
      const data = playing && audioViz.data ? audioViz.data : null;
      canvases.forEach((canvas) => drawVisualizerCanvas(canvas, data, document.title.includes('Plus'), Boolean(playing)));
      updateVisualizerState();
      audioViz.frame = requestAnimationFrame(drawAudioVisualizer);
    }

    function updateVisualizerState() {
      const audio = document.getElementById('musicAudio');
      const playing = Boolean(audio && !audio.paused && !audio.ended && audio.src);
      if (audioViz.lastPlaying === playing) return;
      audioViz.lastPlaying = playing;
      document.querySelectorAll('.visualizer-backdrop, .overlay-visualizer').forEach((element) => {
        element.classList.toggle('active', Boolean(playing));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.cd-disc, .floating-music-disc').forEach((disc) => {
        disc.classList.toggle('playing', Boolean(playing));
        disc.classList.toggle('spinning', Boolean(playing));
      });
    }

    function startAudioVisualizer(audio) {
      ensureAudioVisualizer(audio);
      if (audioViz.context && audioViz.context.state === 'suspended') {
        audioViz.context.resume();
      }
      updateVisualizerState();
      if (!audioViz.frame) {
        audioViz.frame = requestAnimationFrame(drawAudioVisualizer);
      }
    }

    function stopAudioVisualizer() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(audioViz.frame);
      audioViz.frame = 0;
      audioViz.lastFrameTime = 0;
      updateVisualizerState();
      clearVisualizerCanvases();
    }

    function setAlbumArt(url) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.cd-disc').forEach((disc) => disc.classList.add('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.album-art').forEach((image) => {
        if (url) {
          image.src = url;
          image.classList.add('active');
        } else {
          image.removeAttribute('src');
          image.classList.remove('active');
        }
      });
      updateVisualizerState();
    }

    async function loadMp3CoverArt(file) {
      if (!file || !file.type.includes('mpeg')) {
        setAlbumArt('');
        return;
      }
      try {
        const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
        if (bytes[0] !== 73 || bytes[1] !== 68 || bytes[2] !== 51) {
          setAlbumArt('');
          return;
        }
        const version = bytes[3];
        const tagSize = ((bytes[6] & 127) << 21) | ((bytes[7] & 127) << 14) | ((bytes[8] & 127) << 7) | (bytes[9] & 127);
        let offset = 10;
        const end = Math.min(bytes.length, 10 + tagSize);
        while (offset + 10 <= end) {
          const frameId = String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset], bytes[offset + 1], bytes[offset + 2], bytes[offset + 3]);
          const frameSize = version === 4
            ? ((bytes[offset + 4] & 127) << 21) | ((bytes[offset + 5] & 127) << 14) | ((bytes[offset + 6] & 127) << 7) | (bytes[offset + 7] & 127)
            : (bytes[offset + 4] << 24) | (bytes[offset + 5] << 16) | (bytes[offset + 6] << 8) | bytes[offset + 7];
          if (!frameId.trim() || frameSize <= 0) break;
          const frameStart = offset + 10;
          const frameEnd = Math.min(frameStart + frameSize, bytes.length);
          if (frameId === 'APIC') {
            let cursor = frameStart + 1;
            while (cursor < frameEnd && bytes[cursor] !== 0) cursor++;
            const mime = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(frameStart + 1, cursor)) || 'image/jpeg';
            cursor += 2;
            while (cursor < frameEnd && bytes[cursor] !== 0) cursor++;
            cursor++;
            const blob = new Blob([bytes.slice(cursor, frameEnd)], { type: mime });
            setAlbumArt(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
            return;
          }
          offset = frameEnd;
        }
        setAlbumArt('');
      } catch (error) {
        setAlbumArt('');
      }
    }

    function initMusicPlayer() {
      const audio = document.getElementById('musicAudio');
      const picker = document.getElementById('musicFilePicker');
      const uploadBtn = document.getElementById('musicUploadBtn');
      const playBtn = document.getElementById('musicPlayPauseBtn');
      const loopBtn = document.getElementById('musicLoopBtn');
      const volumeSlider = document.getElementById('musicVolumeSlider');
      const volumeValue = document.getElementById('musicVolumeValue');
      const label = document.getElementById('musicTrackLabel');
      const status = document.getElementById('musicStatus');
      if (!audio || !picker || !uploadBtn || !playBtn || !loopBtn || !label || !status) return;
      const syncVolume = () => {
        if (!volumeSlider) return;
        const nextVolume = Number(volumeSlider.value) / 100;
        audio.volume = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, nextVolume));
        if (volumeValue) volumeValue.textContent = `${Math.round(audio.volume * 100)}%`;
      };
      if (volumeSlider) {
        syncVolume();
        volumeSlider.addEventListener('input', syncVolume);
      }

      uploadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => picker.click());
      picker.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = picker.files && picker.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        audio.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        label.textContent = file.name;
        status.textContent = 'Loaded and ready.';
        loadMp3CoverArt(file);
      });

      playBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!audio.src) {
          status.textContent = 'Upload a song first.';
          return;
        }
        if (audio.paused) {
          await audio.play();
          startAudioVisualizer(audio);
          playBtn.textContent = 'Pause';
          status.textContent = 'Playing.';
        } else {
          audio.pause();
          playBtn.textContent = 'Play';
          status.textContent = 'Paused.';
          stopAudioVisualizer();
        }
      });

      audio.addEventListener('pause', stopAudioVisualizer);
      audio.addEventListener('ended', stopAudioVisualizer);
      audio.addEventListener('play', () => startAudioVisualizer(audio));

      loopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        audio.loop = !audio.loop;
        loopBtn.textContent = audio.loop ? 'Loop On' : 'Loop Off';
      });
    }

    function initPlayerButtonFallbacks() {
      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (!(target instanceof Element)) return;
        const audio = document.getElementById('musicAudio');
        const status = document.getElementById('musicStatus');
        if (target.id === 'musicUploadBtn') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          const picker = document.getElementById('musicFilePicker');
          if (picker) picker.click();
        }
        if (target.id === 'musicPlayPauseBtn') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          if (!audio || !audio.src) {
            if (status) status.textContent = 'Upload a song first.';
            return;
          }
          if (audio.paused) {
            audio.play()
              .then(() => {
                startAudioVisualizer(audio);
                target.textContent = 'Pause';
                if (status) status.textContent = 'Playing.';
              })
              .catch(() => {
                if (status) status.textContent = 'Could not start playback.';
              });
          } else {
            audio.pause();
            target.textContent = 'Play';
            if (status) status.textContent = 'Paused.';
            stopAudioVisualizer();
          }
        }
        if (target.id === 'musicLoopBtn') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          if (!audio) return;
          audio.loop = !audio.loop;
          target.textContent = audio.loop ? 'Loop On' : 'Loop Off';
        }
      }, true);
    }

    function unloadGameImages() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.game-card img, img.game-image').forEach((image) => {
        if (image.dataset.unloadedForGame === 'true') return;
        image.dataset.unloadedForGame = 'true';
        if (image.getAttribute('src')) {
          image.dataset.savedSrc = image.getAttribute('src');
          image.removeAttribute('src');
        }
        if (image.getAttribute('srcset')) {
          image.dataset.savedSrcset = image.getAttribute('srcset');
          image.removeAttribute('srcset');
        }
      });
    }

    function restoreGameImages() {
      document.querySelectorAll('img[data-unloaded-for-game="true"]').forEach((image) => {
        if (image.dataset.savedSrc) {
          image.setAttribute('src', image.dataset.savedSrc);
          delete image.dataset.savedSrc;
        }
        if (image.dataset.savedSrcset) {
          image.setAttribute('srcset', image.dataset.savedSrcset);
          delete image.dataset.savedSrcset;
        }
        delete image.dataset.unloadedForGame;
      });
    }

    function initGameImageUnloader() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
      if (!overlay) return;

      const syncImages = () => {
        if (overlay.classList.contains('active')) {
          unloadGameImages();
        } else {
          restoreGameImages();
        }
      };

      new MutationObserver(syncImages).observe(overlay, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class']
      });
      syncImages();
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const input = document.getElementById('shortzInput');
      const searchBar = document.getElementById('searchBar');
      const musicCollapseBtn = document.getElementById('musicCollapseBtn');
      const closeGameBtn = document.getElementById('closeOverlayBtn');

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        const grid = document.getElementById('gamesGrid');
        if (grid && !grid.children.length) {
          renderStarterGames();
        }
      }, 1400);
      renderFavorites();
      initMusicPlayer();
      initPlayerButtonFallbacks();
      initGameImageUnloader();
      initCloseWarning();
      updateVisualizerState();

      if (musicCollapseBtn) musicCollapseBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMusicPlayer);
      if (closeGameBtn) {
        closeGameBtn.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          genieCloseGame();
        }, true);
      }
      if (input) {
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
          if (event.key === 'Enter') {
            event.preventDefault();
            searchShortz();
          }
        });
      }

      if (searchBar) {
        searchBar.addEventListener('input', () => {
          if (!fallbackGamesActive) return;
          const grid = document.getElementById('gamesGrid');
          const activeFilterButton = document.querySelector('.filter-btn.active[data-filter]');
          if (grid) grid.innerHTML = '';
          renderStarterGames(activeFilterButton ? activeFilterButton.dataset.filter : 'all', searchBar.value);
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn[data-filter]').forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (!fallbackGamesActive) return;
          document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn[data-filter]').forEach((btn) => btn.classList.remove('active'));
          button.classList.add('active');
          const grid = document.getElementById('gamesGrid');
          if (grid) grid.innerHTML = '';
          renderStarterGames(button.dataset.filter, searchBar ? searchBar.value : '');
        });
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (!fallbackGamesActive) return;
        const favoriteButton = event.target.closest('.favorite-btn[data-game]');
        if (!favoriteButton) return;
        const game = favoriteButton.dataset.game;
        const favorites = getFavorites();
        const nextFavorites = favorites.includes(game)
          ? favorites.filter((item) => item !== game)
          : favorites.concat(game);
        saveFavorites(nextFavorites);
        favoriteButton.classList.toggle('favorited', nextFavorites.includes(game));
        renderFavorites();
      });

      document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        const shortzPage = document.getElementById('shortz');
        const gameOverlay = document.getElementById('gameOverlay');
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && gameOverlay && gameOverlay.classList.contains('active')) {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          genieCloseGame();
          return;
        }
        if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' && shortzPage && shortzPage.classList.contains('active')) {
          event.preventDefault();
          nextShort();
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
  <script async data-id="101481770" src="https://static.getclicky.com/js"></script>
</body>
</html>
